behaviors.title: Behavior contracts remain compatible and conservative
invariants: Legacy v1 contracts remain valid but never appear edge-profiled.
Tier 1 and Tier 2 evidence cannot change Tier-0 release readiness.

scenarios.title: Compatibility and profile status remain distinct
scenarios.oracle: A valid v1 contract assesses normally with legacy edge status, while v2 requires behavior invariants and validates any declared edge profile.

scenarios.title: All tiers project without widening release gates
scenarios.oracle: Coverage contains every Tier 0-2 scenario while required and passed counts, gaps, and release_ready continue to depend only on required Tier-0 scenarios.

behaviors.title: Edge traces become bounded direct-surface receipts
invariants: Quality Runner never self-issues independent edge verification.
Production, destructive, unbounded, or unredacted traces never mint repository receipts.

scenarios.title: Record-edge enforces provenance and safety boundaries
scenarios.oracle: qr behavior record-edge accepts only committed clean v2 targets in local, test, preview, or staging and emits direct_surface evidence after validating replay, minimization, cleanup, bounds, and redaction.

behaviors.title: Edge durability remains auditable across the inventory
invariants: Profile, verification, freshness, failure, blockage, and unknown state remain separate dimensions.

scenarios.title: Coverage projects per tier and edge category
scenarios.oracle: The assessment reports bounded per-scenario records and aggregate total, profiled, verified, stale, failed, blocked, and unknown counts per tier and declared edge category.
